reels.title: The Berry: the finest hotel in Athens, Ohio
reels.text:
In 1893 Edward and Mattie Berry, Black entrepreneurs, opened a hotel on North Court Street that became the best in town. By 1974 it was gone, torn down for a parking lot. A minute from our film, Athens, Ohio: From South Bridge to 2025.

reels.title: Nobody had to say it: Ohio University, 1923 and 2025
reels.text:
In 1923 Ohio University's trustees wrote a rule that never said Black and didn't have to. In 2025 its president told the campus not to recreate the same work "under a different name." A minute from our film, Athens, Ohio: From South Bridge to 2025.
